_comment: School location file IDs that name a school school_master already carries under an older ID. school_id is the public school URL (ADR-007), so the older ID is kept and the new one is not added. Check this list before adding a school from a new location file: a re-issued ID looks like a new school, which is how 달전초 entered school_master twice. Statistics follow schoolinfo_code, which did not change for any of these.
_source: 한국교육시설안전원_초중등학교위치_20261001.csv, compared with 학교알리미 apiType 0/09 (2026) and NEIS schoolInfo
